# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

We pledge to make participation in Nexa Suite respectful, welcoming and harassment-free for everyone, regardless of background, identity, experience or role.

## Expected Behavior

- Use welcoming and inclusive language.
- Be respectful of different viewpoints and experiences.
- Give and receive constructive feedback professionally.
- Focus on what is best for the project and its users.
- Accept responsibility for mistakes and correct them openly.

## Unacceptable Behavior

Harassment, discrimination, intimidation, personal attacks, sexualized language or imagery, unwanted contact, public exposure of private information, retaliation, and any other conduct that would be inappropriate in a professional setting are unacceptable.

## Enforcement Responsibilities

Maintainers clarify and enforce these standards, may remove or edit contributions that violate them, and may take corrective action that is fair and proportionate. They protect reporter privacy as far as practical.

## Scope

This Code applies in project spaces, issue and pull request discussions, events, direct project communication, and whenever conduct affects project participation or community safety.

## Reporting

Report conduct concerns privately to `nexa.business.contact@gmail.com` with the repository name, relevant context, dates, links or evidence, and a safe way to respond. Do not use a public issue for harassment reports.

## Privacy and Consequences

Reports are handled confidentially when possible. Maintainers may issue a warning, remove content, restrict participation or permanently ban conduct that violates this Code. False or malicious reports may also result in corrective action.

## Attribution

Adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct.html), version 2.1.
